temporal_resolution: 50 km block x year x month x day/night
training_evidence: Synthetic mock overlap dataset for pipeline development only; NOT real NASA observations.
disclaimer: CRITICAL: This model was trained on synthetic mock test fixtures. Predictions must NOT be presented as actual NASA observations or scientifically validated historical counts.
limitations: Inability to recover VIIRS-positive detections when Aqua MODIS count is zero (predict_ratio(0, k) = 0).
Coverage-unadjusted preliminary counts: FIRMS positive detections without separate clear-sky pixel evidence are labeled 'unknown'.
Spatial and seasonal homogeneity assumption: applies a constant scalar multiplier across all Pará 50 km blocks without land cover, moisture, or biome covariates.
